pr_title: tree: allow string concat with any type
pr_body:
Previously, the || concat operator only worked on string pairs. Postgres
supports concatenation between strings and any other type. This patch
adds support for that as well.

fixes #41872
fixes #34404

Release note (sql change): the concatenation operator || is now usable
between strings and any other type.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/42258)

```
testdata/eval/concat:8: 'a' || (1 + 2)::char
                expected:
                'a3'
                
                found:
                ambiguous binary operator: <string> || <char>
```

the test failures seem to all relate to string to char concatenation but I'm not sure why this change would affect that.
cc @otan - here's another simple change that has some issues with our type system, just since we were on the topic.

I couldn't figure out how to update a branch of someone else, but i think this is resolvable with ~https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/43142 (no worky)~ ~#43143 (some bug in there tho, non tractable)~ https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/43190.
